source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Causativization as lexicon-internal operation in Sakha
notes: That the content of θ-features does play a role in causativization can be seen from the following piece of data. A verb such as öhös has two senses: transitive agentive ‘oppose’ (+c+m) and intransitive stative ‘be obstinate’ (-c+m). Under causativization only the former meaning is preserved.
